one_line: OpenAI launches policy push and safety programs as AI funding surges and Anthropic expands financially.

themes.title: OpenAI rolls out policy initiatives
themes.text: OpenAI will start a post‑midterm policy campaign proposing safety safeguards, AI speed limits, and rebranding its data centers as “AI compute campuses.” It also unveiled a LifeVal benchmark to assess everyday assistance and a Grid Protectors Program to partner with utilities on power reliability.

stories.headline: OpenAI to launch post‑midterm policy push, propose AI speed limits and rename data centers
OpenAI launches LifeVal benchmark for AI assistance with everyday tasks
OpenAI launches Grid Protectors Program to aid utilities with compute campus power reliability

themes.title: AI startup funding and acquisitions boom
themes.text: Hex Technologies raised $100 million to launch Hex 4.0 for AI agents, while Vera Health, Casap, Bites, 42AI, Tutor Intelligence, ServiceNow, and others secured funding or acquisitions totaling hundreds of millions to expand AI‑driven platforms. These deals highlight a broad surge of capital into AI applications across finance, healthcare, enterprise software, and robotics.

stories.headline: Hex Technologies raises $100 million Series D, launches Hex 4.0 for AI agents
Vera Health raises $28.5 million Series A to expand AI-powered clinical search platform
Casap raises $56 million Series B to expand AI dispute and fraud tools for banks
Bites raises $40 million Series A to expand AI‑driven frontline training platform
42AI emerges from stealth with $62.5 million seed to build behavioral world model
Tutor Intelligence raises $75 million Series B to expand robot model training and deployments
ServiceNow acquires Israeli startup Sweep to speed CRM migrations

themes.title: Anthropic pursues massive compute commitments
themes.text: Anthropic plans to raise up to ¥552.9 billion from Japanese investors in its U.S. IPO and disclosed $895.4 billion in compute‑related purchase commitments and leases. The filings show rapid revenue growth but also a large net loss as the company scales its infrastructure.

stories.headline: Anthropic to raise up to ¥552.9 bn ($3.5 bn) from Japanese investors in US IPO
Anthropic reports $895.4 billion in compute‑related purchase commitments and leases
